name: pi-video-cua
description: Computer-use agent extension for Pi.dev controlling Windows 11 desktop applications and DaVinci Resolve

scripts.build:helper: cargo build --release --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin; Copy-Item helper/target/release/pi-video-cua-helper.exe -Destination bin/ -Force"
scripts.build: npm run build:helper && npm run build:ts
